reading_task: Compare within-depot shares and counts while preserving subtype groups, reported marker annotations and pooled marginal totals.

basis: The white field removes broad alternating bands and continuous vertical rules that competed with the sparse quantitative dots.
Group gaps, narrow categorical strips and three pale separators retain row grouping without boxing each data column.
Normal-weight headers, quieter identifiers and marker text, and an unframed continuous guide reduce the visual weight of decoding aids.
The stronger light endpoint improves contrast of small positive dots on white while preserving exact count-to-size and share-to-color mappings.
comparison.scope: A self-reviewed improvement for this fixed 16-subtype by 3-depot panel; not a generalization or publication-acceptance result.

checks.numeric: passed: 48 source rows and 22539 pooled objects retained; plotted-data.csv unchanged; source-table hash and original TSV contents verified.
checks.mappings: passed: all 16 subtype rows, category assignments, 88*n/2700 scatter size parameters, and 0-40% linear share scale retained.
checks.exports: passed: PDF/SVG 180 by 120 mm, PNG 300 dpi, all PDF text 8 pt, fonts embedded, editable SVG text and no text outside PDF canvas.
checks.legend_geometry: passed: final guide validation has no overlap, clipping or geometry issues.
checks.visual: PNG and independently rasterized PDF inspected for row alignment, required labels, legends, clipping, grouping and color/line hierarchy.

residual_notes: Extremely rare positive counts remain very small at the final physical size; no minimum size, row deletion or replacement values were used.
